calls.statement:
SELECT is_current, tier, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from) AS min_from, max(valid_from) AS max_from, min(valid_to) AS min_to, max(valid_to) AS max_to
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH cur AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) c, sum(CASE WHEN valid_to='9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) open_ended FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1),
allm AS (SELECT member_id, max(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_cur, count(*) n FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cur WHERE c>1) AS multi_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cur WHERE open_ended<>c) AS current_not_open,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM allm WHERE has_cur=0) AS no_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE NOT is_current AND valid_to='9999-12-31') AS noncurrent_open,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to < valid_from) AS bad_range,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date > current_date) AS future_join,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_keys,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_load,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' AND join_date > valid_from) AS gold_join_after_from

calls.statement:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT member_id, tier, valid_from, valid_to, is_current,
         lag(valid_to) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_to
  FROM dim_member
)
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE prev_to IS NOT NULL AND valid_from <= prev_to) AS overlaps,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE prev_to IS NOT NULL AND valid_from > prev_to + 1) AS gaps,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold') AS gold_current_rows,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold') AS gold_current_members,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2026-10-04' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to AND tier='Gold') AS gold_asof_sun,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2026-10-07' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to AND tier='Gold') AS gold_asof_req,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier IS NULL OR tier NOT IN ('Basic','Silver','Gold')) AS odd_tiers,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE tier='Gold') AS gold_all_rows
FROM v

calls.statement:
WITH as_of AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date AS as_of_end FROM dim_date d WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2026-10-04'
),
active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    CROSS JOIN as_of
    WHERE f.sale_date > as_of.as_of_end - 364 AND f.sale_date <= as_of.as_of_end
)
SELECT any_value(as_of.as_of_end) AS as_of_end, count(*) AS active_gold
FROM active a CROSS JOIN as_of
JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id AND as_of.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
WHERE cur.tier = 'Gold'
